title: Use CapCut Desktop’s Seedance 2.5 AI Extend by stacking repeated 30‑second…
content: Use CapCut Desktop’s Seedance 2.5 AI Extend by stacking repeated 30‑second continuation clips to extend a video indefinitely while keeping subjects consistent (avoiding morphing).
